snippet.title: Chip 'n Clawz vs. The Brainioids - Gameplay Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Join the team at Snapshot Games for a closer look at Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids in the latest gameplay deep dive developer diary. The developers from Snapshot Games offer a closer look at what it’s like to battle the Brainioid menace.

Wishlist & Follow on Steam: https://bit.ly/41dRgvB

Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids launches tomorrow, August 26, on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation and Xbox for $29.99! To celebrate this occasion, it will be 10% off across all platforms during its first week of launch (from August 26 until September 2). At launch, Friend’s Pass will be available which will allow you to enjoy online co-op and PvP multiplayer for free with a friend who owns the game. 

Details about Friend's Pass: https://www.chipnclawz.com/en/news/article/11577102

Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids is a new action-packed strategy game set in a colorful, comic book-style world brimming with a unique cast of characters. Whether strategizing in battle or diving into the action firsthand, players will find a uniquely engaging and heroic adventure that keeps them coming back for more. Chip ‘n Clawz vs. The Brainioids will launch on PC, Xbox and PlayStation with cross platform play support.

Join the official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/2DEGRggKA2
